_doc: The King Who Serves voice cast (docs/lastsupper/VOICE.md). narrator / jesus / peter are copied from cast_miracles.json (one Jesus and one Peter across both packs) plus a timbre pin (mfccRef = mean MFCC of Miracles' chosen clips). Run through tools/story/voice_lastsupper.py (runaway guard, crowd takes with a repetition check, f0 / timbre pins from voice_exodus.py).

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈在床边给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
narrator.why: same settings as cast_miracles.json (the two packs share one narrator)

jesus.design: 男性，三十岁左右，嗓音温暖、清亮、柔和圆润，干净不沙哑，平静从容，亲切又带一点点俏皮的笑意，吐字清楚，像一位温柔的好老师，从不吼叫。普通话标准。
jesus.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
jesus.why: same settings as cast_miracles.json (the two packs share one jesus); plus a timbre pin to Miracles' chosen clips

peter.design: 男性，四十多岁，身材高大魁梧的渔夫，低沉浑厚的男低音，胸腔共鸣很重，嗓门大但声音低，豪爽爱笑，热心肠，像一只友好的大熊。就算大喊大叫也是低沉的大嗓门，从不尖细。普通话标准。
peter.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，夸张好笑，但是不吓人，有真实的呼吸。大喊时声音也保持低沉。这一句：
peter.why: same settings as cast_miracles.json (the two packs share one peter); plus a timbre pin to Miracles' chosen clips

john.design: 男性，十八九岁，门徒里最年轻的一个，声音清亮、年轻、有活力，说话快，机灵又有点调皮，后来变得若有所思。普通话标准。
john.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：

james.design: 男性，二十七八岁，约翰的哥哥，自信的男中高音，声音洪亮饱满，有点自以为了不起，爱显摆，但不讨厌。普通话标准。
james.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：

andrew.design: 男性，三十多岁，彼得的弟弟，声音温和、轻柔、低调，说话慢条斯理，平静、淡定，有一点冷幽默，有点害羞，从不大声。普通话标准。
andrew.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
andrew.why: softer and lower-key than Peter (CONTRACT §7); deadpan

seller1.design: 男性，五十岁左右，圆滚滚的胖商贩，嗓门大，声音圆润响亮，乐呵呵的市场叫卖腔，滑稽可爱，不凶。普通话标准。

people.instruct: 路边一大群欢迎国王的人，又唱又喊，非常开心，七嘴八舌，像真人。

members.design: 男孩，七岁左右，声音清脆稚嫩，普通话标准。
女孩，五岁左右，声音又细又甜，奶声奶气，普通话标准。

people.why: Jonah / Miracles crowd (10 Qwen voices incl. a boy of 7 and a girl of 5), children raised to -3/-4 dB for 'a child's voice on top'; outdoors (field fx), 8 mixes, runaway + repetition guard in voice_lastsupper.py

narrator.instruct: A warm woman storyteller, like a mother at a child's bedside telling a Bible story to a child of four to ten: friendly, lively, natural, at a natural flowing pace, never dragging. This line:
narrator.why: same settings as cast_miracles.json (the two packs share one narrator)

jesus.design: A man of about thirty with a warm, clear, soft and round voice, clean and never hoarse, calm and unhurried, kind with a hint of playful smile, crisp diction, like a gentle teacher who never shouts. Clear standard American English.
jesus.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
jesus.why: same settings as cast_miracles.json (the two packs share one jesus); plus a timbre pin to Miracles' chosen clips

peter.design: A man in his forties, a big burly fisherman with a deep, booming bass voice, heavy chest resonance, loud but low, hearty and quick to laugh, warm-hearted like a friendly bear. Even when he shouts his voice stays deep and never turns shrill. Standard American English.
peter.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: comic and big, never scary, with real breaths. Keep the voice deep and low even when shouting. This line:
peter.why: same settings as cast_miracles.json (the two packs share one peter); plus a timbre pin to Miracles' chosen clips

john.design: A young man of about nineteen, the youngest of the friends: a bright, clear, youthful voice, quick and a bit cheeky, later thoughtful. Standard American English.
john.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

james.design: A man of about twenty-seven, John's big brother: a confident, full tenor voice, a little puffed up and pleased with himself, but likeable. Standard American English.
james.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

andrew.design: A man in his thirties, Peter's younger brother: a mild, soft-spoken, low-key voice, calm and unhurried, dry and deadpan, a little shy, never loud. Standard American English.
andrew.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
andrew.why: softer and lower-key than Peter (CONTRACT §7); deadpan

seller1.design: A man of about fifty, a round, jolly market trader: a big, round, booming market-crier voice, comic and cheerful, never nasty. Standard American English.
seller1.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

seller2.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

people.instruct: A big happy crowd by the road welcoming their king, cheering and calling out, all at once, like real people.

members.design: A boy of about seven, bright clear child's voice, standard English.
A girl of about five, thin sweet little voice, standard English.

people.why: Jonah / Miracles crowd (10 Qwen voices incl. a boy of 7 and a girl of 5), children raised to -3/-4 dB for 'a child's voice on top'; outdoors (field fx), 8 mixes, runaway + repetition guard in voice_lastsupper.py

ls_01.m: 故事开场，明亮愉快；说到“小驴”时带着笑意和一点小惊喜
ls_01.m_en: storyteller opening, bright; a smile and a little surprise on 'a little donkey'

ls_02.m: 热闹、越说越起劲，后半句快一点
ls_02.m_en: lively, building; quicker on the second half

ls_03.m: 一大群人一起欢呼，开心，声音此起彼伏，孩子的声音在最上面
ls_03.m_en: crowd, joyful, overlapping; a child's voice on top

ls_04.m: 得意得不得了，挥着棕树枝；说“大人物”时咧嘴大笑，但嗓音低沉
ls_04.m_en: bursting with pride, waving the palm; big grin on 'important'; voice stays deep

phrases.text: 哈哈，大家都知道他是王啦！
phrases.instruct: 得意地笑着喊，嗓音低沉。

phrases.text: Ha ha! Everyone knows He's the King!

ls_05.m: 宗教领袖的抱怨用低一点、拘谨的腔调，不吓人
ls_05.m_en: the grumble in a lower, prim voice; not scary

ls_06.m: 平静笃定，带一点俏皮的笑意，不生气
ls_06.m_en: calm and sure, a twinkle in it; not cross

ls_07.m: 先是疑惑，然后弯下腰对石头小声说话，非常滑稽
ls_07.m_en: puzzled, then leaning in and whispering to the stone, very comic

phrases.instruct: 一脸疑惑，慢慢地自言自语。
弯下腰对着石头小声说，非常滑稽。
leaning in, a loud comic whisper to the stone.

ls_08.m: 响亮的市场叫卖，然后小声对自己嘀咕一句；滑稽，不坏
ls_08.m_en: loud market cry, then a sly aside to himself; comic, not nasty

phrases.instruct: 响亮的市场叫卖，乐呵呵的。
压低声音对自己嘀咕，狡猾又好笑。

phrases.text: Doves! Doves for sale! Cheap, cheap!

phrases.instruct: a sly aside to himself, quieter, comic.

ls_09.m: 安静一点，有点难过；“祷告的地方”说得慢
ls_09.m_en: quieter, a little sad; slow on 'God's house'

ls_10.m: 坚定有力、清楚；底下是难过，绝不是暴怒大吼
ls_10.m_en: firm and strong, clear; sad underneath, never shouting in rage

ls_11.m: 滑稽的慌张，弯着腰追硬币
ls_11.m_en: comic panic, bent double chasing coins

phrases.instruct: 弯着腰追硬币，又急又好笑。
bent double chasing coins, flustered and funny.

ls_12.m: 滑稽地哀嚎，像鸟一样拍着手臂
ls_12.m_en: wailing, comic, flapping his arms like a bird

phrases.instruct: 难以置信，拖着哭腔，滑稽。

ls_13.m: 温暖；耶稣不只是生气，他爱上帝的家；最后孩子们的“和散那”扬起来
ls_13.m_en: warm; Jesus was not just angry, He loved God's house; lift into the children's 'Hosanna' at the end

ls_14.m: 温馨的晚上的语气，最后意味深长地停一下
ls_14.m_en: cosy evening voice, then a knowing little pause at the end

ls_16.m: 最小的那个，又快又调皮

ls_17.m: 又大又响，拍着胸脯，嗓音低沉
ls_17.m_en: big and loud, thumbs at his chest; voice stays deep

phrases.text: 喂喂喂！我是第一个跟耶稣的，
Hey, hey, hey! I was the first one to follow Jesus.

ls_18.m: 温和，有点害羞，一本正经；笑点在于他特别平静
ls_18.m_en: mild, a little shy, deadpan; the joke is in how calm he is

phrases.text: 是我先带你去见耶稣的。
phrases.instruct: 平静、一本正经，淡淡地说。
mild and a little shy, slowly.

phrases.text: I'm the one who took you to meet Jesus.

ls_19.m: 被说中了，慌张结巴，滑稽

en.pickWhy: take 7 (only err-0 take) measured 425 Hz median, a squeak; take 5 says every word ('Err' was not in asrIgnore) and is lower

ls_20.m: 朴素温和；“谁也不愿意”轻轻叹口气
ls_20.m_en: plain and gentle; a small sigh on 'nobody wanted'

ls_21.m: 轻声、慢慢地，带着惊奇；省略号处停久一点
ls_21.m_en: hushed, slow, with wonder; long pause at the dots

phrases.text: 耶稣在腰上束了一条毛巾，把水倒进盆里……
然后跪下来，给门徒洗脚。
Jesus tied a towel round His waist, poured water into a bowl...
then knelt down and began to wash their feet.

ls_23.m: 震惊又不好意思，举起双手把脚缩回去；大声但嗓音低沉
ls_23.m_en: shocked and embarrassed, hands up, pulling his feet back; loud but deep

phrases.instruct: 震惊又不好意思，嗓音低沉。
大声拒绝，摆着手，嗓音保持低沉。

phrases.text: Lord, You're going to wash MY feet?

phrases.instruct: a loud refusal, waving his hands, still deep.

ls_24.m: 非常温柔、有耐心，抬头看着他
ls_24.m_en: very gentle, patient, looking up at him

ls_25.m: 一下子全豁出去了，滑稽地过分热情，声音越来越高但仍然低沉
ls_25.m_en: all in at once, comic over-eagerness, rising but still deep

phrases.text: 手也洗，头也洗，全身都洗吧！
phrases.instruct: 滑稽地过分热情，越说越快。

phrases.text: What? Then not just my feet!
My hands and my head too! Wash all of me!

ls_26.m: 先温暖地真笑两声，很疼爱他
ls_26.m_en: a warm, real laugh first; fond

ls_27.m: 安静朴素，不夸张；“还是”轻轻加重
ls_27.m_en: quiet and plain, no drama; a soft weight on 'as well'

ls_28.m: 温暖、清楚、不慌不忙，对四个人说
ls_28.m_en: warm, clear, unhurried; to all four

ls_29.m: 简单温柔，这是故事的核心；慢
ls_29.m_en: simple and gentle, the heart of the story; slow

ls_30.m: 敬虔朴素；慢，每个动作一拍
ls_30.m_en: reverent and simple; slow, each action its own beat

ls_31.m: 安静、温柔、郑重，看着每一个人
ls_31.m_en: quiet, tender, deliberate; looking at each of them

ls_32.m: 非常温柔平静；不悲伤，满是爱
ls_32.m_en: very gentle and calm; not sad, full of love

ls_33.m: 先慢慢地若有所思，然后温暖、开心地下定决心；嗓音低沉
ls_33.m_en: first slow and thoughtful, then a warm, cheerful decision; deep voice

phrases.instruct: 慢慢地、若有所思，轻声，嗓音低沉。

phrases.text: 安得烈，来，把脚伸出来——这回轮到我了！
Andrew, come on, feet out! It's my turn now!
Brother, you're even slower than Jesus!

ls_35.m: 温暖地讲道理，直接对孩子说；慢而清楚
ls_35.m_en: warm moral, straight to the child; slow and clear

ls_36.m: 鼓励、带着微笑；“真正的大人物”扬起来
ls_36.m_en: encouraging, a smile; lift on 'truly great'
